findings.title: Key-holding containers read attacker-controlled trees; symlink to /proc/*/environ bypasses path-based /proc deny
findings.fix: Research gets a symlink-free per-run ro snapshot volume (ossbot-ro-<run_id>) built by a network-none package job; agent-llm mounts no task volume and does all fs ops through ossbot-execd tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/run) with realpath+O_NOFOLLOW; extend denies to /proc,/sys,/dev,/run; [VERIFY] Kiro symlink canonicalization; tests S-symlink-1, live probe, argv test.

findings.title: Hermes API-server platform has full toolset by default (terminal, file, code_execution, delegation, cronjob); 'file write off / skills read' is unbuildable; no runtime tool-surface check while Hermes can read its Kiro key and has web_public egress
findings.fix: Allowlist platform toolsets to memory, todo, session_search, ossbot (key name [VERIFY]); disabled_toolsets as second layer; gatekeeper checks effective tools at start and hourly and kills Hermes on drift; unit test + doctor probe; remove 'keep clarify' and 'skills (read)'.

findings.title: V3 headless enables knowledge and code intelligence by default (verified); not disabled in key-holding containers
findings.fix: Bake chat.enableKnowledge=false and chat.enableCodeIntelligence=false into sandbox and Hermes Kiro settings; doctor asserts; add to 23 item 5.

findings.title: Live safety probes and the --trust-all-tools fallback are not a gate
findings.fix: Persist safety_probe rows keyed by (kiro version, sandbox-llm digest, agent config hash, trust mode); sandboxd refuses kiro jobs without a passing row; trust-all only if probes passed under it; re-run on kiro upgrade.

findings.title: Sandbox input/output plumbing infeasible for ro and none modes (PUT archive into ro volume rejected; ossbot-in mount missing; nested mountpoints; rw-mode input/output on shared attacker-writable volume)
findings.fix: stage-in container fills ossbot-in-<run_id> at /in; every mode mounts in ro at /work/input and out rw at /work/output; repo_mode none uses tmpfs /work; fetch pre-creates dirs; update argv template and tests.

findings.title: Docker filter allowlist omits HostConfig keys the template emits (Tmpfs, Ulimits, MemorySwap, DnsSearch); agent-exec readiness uses exec which the filter denies
findings.fix: Enumerate allowed HostConfig keys with constraints; readiness via MCP relay connect-retry up to 30 s and container State.Running inspect, no exec.

findings.title: Kill/reboot/resume unit semantics contradict AC 9; full kill not distinguished on reboot; enforce-resume does not start gatekeeper
findings.fix: killed JSON level soft|full; firewall and dockerfilter always run; gatekeeper+proxy ExecCondition pass unless level=full; resume starts gatekeeper and proxy; reword AC 9; extend test_kill.ps1.

findings.title: Firewall unit ordering contradictory (Before and After docker) and services do not fail closed without rules
findings.fix: Split ossbot-firewall (Before=docker) and ossbot-firewall-docker (After/BindsTo docker); all ossbot units Requires+After both plus ExecStartPre rule check; fail-closed system test.

findings.title: INPUT DROP of NEW from 10.212.0.0/24 likely blocks the proxy's DNS to the WSL tunnel resolver; untagged
findings.fix: Render ACCEPT for udp/tcp 53 from 10.212.0.2 to resolv.conf nameserver above the DROP (or squid dns_nameservers); [VERIFY] Docker 29 embedded DNS forwarding namespace; doctor probe getent in proxy.

findings.title: ReadOnlyPaths on the repo mount for all non-root units blocks the gatekeeper's models.yaml writes
findings.fix: Gatekeeper unit ReadWritePaths=<repo>/config; others stay read-only; system test.

findings.title: push_update/watch-fix flow underspecified and contradictory (creator of action, base object availability, task volume lifecycle, verification rules, post-approval states)
findings.fix: /package creates push_update when pr_number set; drop push_update from worker /v1/actions; keep task volume until terminal; unbundle last approved bundle before fix; verify fork branch tip == old_head_sha == head_sha, one commit on top; no force push in v1.

findings.title: Live checks and rate-limit counters not defined per action kind; push_update and own-PR comments always refused as written
findings.fix: Per-kind table of live checks and counters; 'other open PR' excludes our branch; parametrized tests.

findings.title: Approval cards for comment, issue_claim and push_update not specified
findings.fix: Comment/claim card with verbatim escaped body, target, mode, checks, delivered-before-Approve, mode-stating confirm; push_update card with derived old..head patch; golden tests.

findings.title: Ambiguous whether upstream_base_tip is re-fetched into the binding at Confirm/submit (would supersede nearly every approval on busy repos)
findings.fix: Binding uses the value stored at /package; live re-fetch goes to refs/upstream-live only for the ancestry check; test upstream move does not supersede.

findings.title: Gatekeeper mirror fetch scope, storage, retention and backup unspecified; full upstream fetch per rev and backing mirrors up is costly
findings.fix: Per-upstream cache bare repo (refs/upstream only) + per-rev mirrors via alternates with only needed ref values; delete superseded/terminal mirrors; backups exclude mirrors and cache; weekly gc.

findings.title: State-machine actor gaps: VETTED->SKIPPED W vs prose G; IMPORTED->VALIDATING missing; any->FAILED actor undefined
findings.fix: W|G for claim skip; IMPORTED:{VALIDATING:G}; FAILED W from working states, G from approval/submit states.

findings.title: Config snapshot hash 'canonical concatenation' undefined
findings.fix: Length-prefixed, name-sorted concatenation.

findings.title: Line-ending normalization only inside the hash contradicts 'posted exactly as hashed'
findings.fix: Normalize at storage time.

findings.title: /approve re-send must mint new message-bound tokens and invalidate the old card's tokens
findings.fix: Specify in the same transaction.

findings.title: Dry-run claim satisfies guard; after dry-run off a live PR can go out without the required claim
findings.fix: /package requires a LIVE done claim when dry_run=false and requires_claim_comment.

findings.title: models.resolve passes unverified ids vs sandboxd exact-catalog rule
findings.fix: sandboxd accepts catalog ids plus DB-recorded --force ids.

findings.title: Anchor socket listener unit undefined
findings.fix: ossbot-anchor.socket + root service; empty payload; root reads head itself; 1/s rate limit.

findings.title: kill.ps1 has no timeout on wsl.exe
findings.fix: 30 s timeout then wsl --terminate ossbot.

findings.title: Network removal fails while proxy is attached
findings.fix: docker network disconnect -f <net> ossbot-proxy before rm.

findings.title: Sandbox tests should probe proxy:3140/3141/3150 via the task alias
findings.fix: Add the probes.

findings.title: Kiro admin governance (verified) may block local stdio MCP or web fetch
findings.fix: Add [VERIFY]; fail-closed already via exit 3.

findings.title: paused-file reconciliation on gatekeeper start unspecified; 24 h stale-callback drop has no timestamp basis
findings.fix: Reconcile paused into control_state; rely on token TTLs.
